header: Repository-wide classification of the helpers outside every registered family (G-4; meta/library_classification.py).
names: every residual repeated normalized name (repeated in the inventory, claimed by no family normalized_names).
body_shapes: every repeated non-empty body shape whose helpers are in no repeated-name group and are no family source.
Out of scope: singletons (a normalized name or body shape held once) and the empty-body group (bodiless declarations).
paper_specific: different notions or carriers behind one name or body, or one paper vocabulary; kept local.
family_companion: Marc's compatibility alias: a companion, bridge or projection of a REGISTERED family (checked).
candidate_family: a reusable notion with its proposed family and a milestone; joins_registered: a further copy of a registered notion.
A milestone records a plan; it deletes nothing and licenses no statement change.

alias_retention_exceptions (G-5, meta/library_alias_retention.py): packages_without_project = the repository namespaces without a regular _CoqProject (the declared set must equal the observed one); accepted_fallbacks = exact (path, reason) ProviderContext fallbacks whose error is suppressed, never a count; an entry that no longer applies is stale.

alias_milestones (G-5): one milestone per retained alias (retain:frozen-statement, retain:certificate, removable-now or remove-after:<milestone>), allowed by its computed alias_retention row; authored from the rule-derived --suggest-milestones listing, every difference listed in the review packet.

post-rc-library-wave.description: the first library migration wave after the RC: it registers or extends the candidate families named here, each through the twelve-step protocol

post-rc-alias-retirement.description: the retirement of retained compatibility aliases after the RC: each alias with this milestone is removed only by a separate reviewed change, once its consumers are migrated
